name: Argentina
note: Roles from the Código Civil y Comercial de la Nación (Ley 26.994). Argentina answers impaired capacity with support measures first and curatorship only for incapacity, and has no durable financial power: the mandate ends on the incapacity of either party, while health directives may be made expressly in anticipation of incapacity. Succession vests without a grant. The separate transplant statute (Ley 27.447) was not retrieved, so only the Code’s body-donation rule is recorded.

citations.title: Normas aplicables
citations.quote: Normas aplicables. La curatela se rige por las reglas de la tutela no modificadas en esta Sección. citations.title: Libertad de aceptar o renunciar
citations.quote: Libertad de aceptar o renunciar. Todo heredero puede aceptar la herencia que le es deferida o renunciarla, pero no puede hacerlo por una parte de la herencia ni sujetar su opción a modalidades. roles.name: Persona de apoyo
roles.summary: Argentina’s default response to impaired capacity is support, not substitution. A support measure may be judicial or extrajudicial, and its stated purpose is to promote autonomy and facilitate the person’s own communication, understanding and expression of will.

assigned.event: Judge restricts capacity for specified acts and designates one or more support persons, or a support is arranged extrajudicially

starts.event: The judgment sets the extent and scope of the restriction and specifies the functions and acts limited, keeping the intrusion on personal autonomy as small as possible

states.label: Support designated, scope set by judgment

transitions.event: Judge restricts capacity for specified acts and designates apoyos (arts 32, 43)
Judgment specifies the functions and acts limited, minimising the effect on autonomy (art 38)
Death of the person opens the succession (art 2277)

roles.name: Curador
roles.summary: Reserved for incapacity rather than restricted capacity. The curator’s main function is to care for the person and property of the incapable person and to try to restore their health — income from their property must preferentially be spent on that.

assigned.event: Judge declares incapacity and designates a curator

starts.event: On designation; the curator cares for the person and the property of the incapable person

states.label: Curator caring for person and property

transitions.event: Judge declares incapacity and designates a curador (arts 32, 138)
Death of the protected person (art 2277)

roles.name: Persona designada en directivas médicas anticipadas
roles.summary: A fully capable person may issue advance directives and confer a mandate about their health in anticipation of their own incapacity, and may name who is to give consent to medical acts and to act as curator. Directives amounting to euthanasia are treated as unwritten.

assigned.event: Fully capable person anticipates directives and designates the person who is to express consent to medical acts and to exercise the curatela

starts.event: In anticipation of the grantor’s own incapacity

states.label: Designated person consenting to medical acts

transitions.event: Fully capable person issues advance directives and designates a decision maker (art 60)
The grantor’s own incapacity, as anticipated in the directive (art 60)
Death of the grantor (art 2277)

nameEn.en: Person named in advance medical directives

roles.name: Persona con derecho a decidir las exequias
roles.summary: A fully capable person may direct the manner and circumstances of their funeral and burial in any form. If no wish was expressed or can be presumed, the decision falls to the spouse, then the cohabitant, and failing them the relatives.

assigned.event: The person directs the manner and circumstances of their exequias in any form; otherwise the statutory order applies

transitions.event: The person directs the manner and circumstances of exequias, in any form (art 61)
No wish expressed or presumed: spouse, then cohabitant, then relatives decide (art 61)
Death of the person (arts 61, 2277)
Funeral and burial carried out (art 61)

nameEn.en: Person entitled to decide the funeral

roles.name: Persona que decide la dación del cadáver
roles.summary: The same article that governs funerals lets a fully capable person give all or part of their body for therapeutic, scientific or teaching purposes, and passes the decision to the spouse, cohabitant or relatives where no wish was expressed. The separate transplant statute was not retrieved for this entry.

assigned.event: Fully capable person directs the giving of all or part of the body for therapeutic, scientific, teaching or similar purposes

ends.event: Decision taken and the body or part given or refused

transitions.event: Person directs the giving of all or part of the body (art 61)
No wish expressed or presumed: spouse, cohabitant, then relatives decide (art 61)
Death of the person (arts 61, 2277)
Decision taken (art 61)

nameEn.en: Person deciding the giving of the body

roles.name: Apoderado (mandatario)
roles.summary: An ordinary power. It is not durable: the mandate ends on the death or incapacity of either party, and the power itself ends on the death of representative or represented, save for a special power granted for determined acts in a legitimate interest.

assigned.event: Principal grants a power for the acts entrusted

starts.event: On the grant of the power

ends.event: Death or incapacity of either party, revocation by the principal, or renunciation by the mandatary
Death of the represented person; the power survives only where granted for specially determined acts in a legitimate interest

transitions.event: Principal grants the power (art 380)
Death or incapacity of mandante or mandatario, revocation, or renunciation (art 1329)
Death of representative or represented, subject to the special-power exception (art 380(b))

roles.name: Heredero
roles.summary: Death opens the succession and transmits the estate. Descendants, ascendants and the spouse are invested as heirs from the day of death with no formality and no judicial intervention, even if unaware; collateral and testamentary heirs must be invested by the succession judge.

assigned.event: Real or presumed death opens the succession and transmits the estate to those called by will or by law

starts.event: Descendants, ascendants and spouse are invested from the day of death without formality or judicial intervention; collaterals and testamentary heirs are invested by the judge

ends.event: Renunciation, or the right to accept lapsing ten years after the succession opens, the heir then being treated as renouncing

states.label: Invested by operation of law on death

transitions.event: Death opens the succession; descendants, ascendants and spouse invested from that day (arts 2277, 2337)
Collateral or testamentary heirs invested by the succession judge (art 2338)
Acceptance of the inheritance (art 2287)
Renunciation, or the option lapsing ten years after the succession opens (arts 2287, 2288)

roles.name: Albacea
roles.summary: Named in testamentary form. The albacea’s powers are those the testator confers and, failing that, whatever the circumstances make necessary to carry out the will. The testator cannot excuse the albacea from inventorying the estate or rendering accounts.

assigned.event: Testator names an albacea in testamentary form, though not necessarily in the will being executed

starts.event: On death, with the powers the testator conferred or those necessary in the circumstances to carry out the will

ends.event: The will is carried out and accounts rendered

transitions.event: Testator names an albacea in testamentary form (art 2524)
Death of the testator; albacea exercises the conferred or necessary powers (arts 2277, 2523)
Will carried out; inventory and accounts rendered (art 2523)

roles.name: Administrador de la herencia
roles.summary: The estate administrator. Fully capable natural persons, and legal persons authorised by law or by their statutes to administer the property of others, may hold the office.

assigned.event: A fully capable person, or a legal person authorised to administer the property of others, takes the office of administrator

transitions.event: Administrator takes office (art 2345)
Administration of the estate completed (art 2345)

poaDurableByDefault.note: The mandate is extinguished by the death or incapacity of either mandante or mandatario, and the power by the death of representative or represented.

springingPoaAllowed.note: Only for health: a fully capable person may anticipate directives and confer a mandate about their health in anticipation of their own incapacity. No equivalent for property.

healthAgentStartsOn.note: The directive and the health mandate are made in anticipation of the grantor’s own incapacity.

supportedDecisionMakingStatute.name: Medidas de apoyo, Código Civil y Comercial arts 32, 38 and 43

probateGrantName.value: investidura de la calidad de heredero
probateGrantName.note: No grant for the closest heirs: descendants, ascendants and the spouse are invested from the day of death without formality. Collateral and testamentary heirs are invested by the succession judge.
